name: The Typewriter That Writes Tomorrow
description: An antique typewriter perched on a floating desk in space, typing out newspapers with headlines about future events, with galaxies swirling behind it and time particles drifting around.
prompt: Vintage antique typewriter floating in space on ornate desk, typing newspapers with futuristic headlines, galaxies swirling in background, time particles and clock gears drifting around, cosmic lighting, detailed mechanical textures, surreal atmosphere, deep space setting
caption: Some stories haven't happened yet... but this machine already knows them. 📰🚀
